because.englishDescription: A cause or reason for a certain incident.
A cause or reason for a certain incident.

fireworks.definitionKo: 밤에 화약을 공중으로 쏘아 올려 여러 가지 빛깔과 모양의 불꽃이 퍼지게 하는 일.
fireworks.englishDescription: The act of showing sparks of various colors and shapes by shooting explosive compounds into the air at night.
A fun activity shooting explosive compounds into the air.

growling.definitionKo: 무엇이 모자라거나 마음에 들지 않아 떼를 쓰며 조르는 일.
growling.englishDescription: An act of badgering someone for more of something or for a new one, when something is in shortage or is not satisfactory.

invalidating.definitionKo: 법이나 규칙 등이 효력을 잃어버려서 쓸데없는 것이 됨. 또는 그렇게 함.
invalidating.englishDescription: A state of ending up useless due to loss of the effects of a law, a rule, etc.; or an act of making it happen.

laundromat.definitionKo: 세탁기에 동전을 넣고 빨래를 할 수 있도록 시설을 갖춘 곳.
laundromat.englishDescription: A place equipped with coin-operated washing machines.

nanjung-ilgi.definitionKo: 임진왜란 때 충무공 이순신이 쓴 일기. 임진왜란이 일어난 1592년부터 전사한 1598년까지의 일이 기록되어 있어 임진왜란 연구에 중요한 자료가 되고 있다.
nanjung-ilgi.englishDescription: The journal of Admiral Yi Sunsin, which he kept from the Japanese invasion of the Joseon Dynasty in 1592 to his death in 1598; it is important research material to study the Japanese invasion of the Joseon Dynasty.

raisin.englishDescription: A dried, small and shrunken grape.

self-praise.definitionKo: 자신이 한 일에 대해 생색내며 스스로 자랑함.
self-praise.englishDescription: The act of taking credit for oneself for a job and being proud of it.

self-praise.definitionKo: 자기 자신이나 자기가 한 일을 스스로 칭찬함.
self-praise.englishDescription: The act of praising oneself or what one did.
The act of bragging about what one has done.

significantly.definitionKo: 사이가 많이 벌어져 있는 상태로. 또는 차이가 매우 심하게.
significantly.englishDescription: In the state of a gap being very wide or difference being great.
In the manner of attaching importance or significance.

solemnity.englishDescription: The quality of being grave, quiet or gentle.

terminal.definitionKo: 컴퓨터의 중앙 처리 장치와 연결되어 자료를 입력하거나 출력하는 기기.
terminal.englishDescription: A device communicating with the CPU of a computer used to input or output data.

terminal.definitionKo: 컴퓨터의 중앙 처리 장치와 연결되어 자료를 입력하거나 출력하는 장치.
terminal.englishDescription: A device communicating with the CPU of a computer used to input or output data.

tinting.definitionKo: 물을 들이거나 색을 칠해서 빛깔이 나게 함.
tinting.englishDescription: An act of dyeing or coloring something to give it a certain color.

well.definitionKo: 어떤 일에 뛰어나게. 또는 어떤 일에 넉넉하게.
well.englishDescription: Excellently in something; or sufficiently in something.

well.definitionKo: 몸이 건강하고 튼튼하다.
well.englishDescription: One's body being healthy and well.

well.definitionKo: 사실을 말할 때, 상대의 생각을 가볍게 반박하거나 새롭게 일깨워 주는 뜻으로 하는 말.
well.englishDescription: An exclamation used to refute the other party's opinion lightly or to inform him/her of a new piece of information.

well.definitionKo: 상대방의 물음이나 요구에 대하여 분명하지 않은 태도를 나타낼 때 쓰는 말.
well.englishDescription: An exclamation used when showing an uncertain attitude toward someone's question or demand.

well.definitionKo: 특별한 의미 없이 단지 대화를 시작할 때 쓰는 말.
well.englishDescription: A word used to begin a conversation without a special meaning.

well.definitionKo: 익숙하고 솜씨 있게.
well.englishDescription: In a familiar and skillful manner.

well.definitionKo: 아주 멋지고 예쁘게.
well.englishDescription: In a very beautiful and pretty manner.

well.definitionKo: 기능이나 효과가 만족스럽게.
well.englishDescription: In a manner of a function or effect being satisfactory.

well.definitionKo: 성질이나 성향이 어떤 상태가 되거나 어떤 행동을 하기 쉽게.
well.englishDescription: With the nature or personality that easily leads someone or something to be in a certain state or act in a certain way.

well.definitionKo: 부유하고 만족스럽게.
well.englishDescription: In an opulent and satisfactory manner.

well.definitionKo: 분명하고 정확하게.
well.englishDescription: Clearly and precisely.

well.definitionKo: 아주 적절하고 알맞게.
well.englishDescription: In a very appropriate and proper manner.

well.definitionKo: 아무 탈 없이 편안하게.
well.englishDescription: Comfortably and without difficulties.

well.definitionKo: 충분히 만족스럽게.
well.englishDescription: In a sufficiently satisfactory manner.

well.definitionKo: 친절하고 정성스럽게.
well.englishDescription: Kindly and with care.

well.definitionKo: 바르고 선하게.
well.englishDescription: Rightly and virtuously.

well.definitionKo: 칭찬할 만큼 아주 훌륭하고 좋게.
well.englishDescription: In a splendid and excellent manner that is worthy of praise.

well.definitionKo: 상대방의 물음이나 요구에 대하여 분명하지 않은 태도를 나타낼 때 쓰는 말.
well.englishDescription: An exclamation used when showing an uncertain attitude toward someone's question or demand.

well.definitionKo: 모자람이 없이 넉넉하게.
well.englishDescription: Enough, with nothing missing or wanting.

well.definitionKo: 살림이나 수입이 넉넉하여 실속 있다.
well.englishDescription: One's household size or income being enough and substantial.

well.definitionKo: 특별한 의미 없이 단지 대화를 시작할 때 쓰는 말.
well.englishDescription: A word used to begin a conversation without a special meaning.

well.definitionKo: 물을 긷기 위해 땅을 파서 지하수가 모이도록 한 곳.
well.englishDescription: A hole dug to collect underground water for human use.

well.definitionKo: 마음먹은 대로.
well.englishDescription: As one has planned to.

well.definitionKo: 사실을 말할 때, 상대의 생각을 가볍게 반박하거나 새롭게 일깨워 주는 뜻으로 하는 말.
well.englishDescription: An exclamation used to refute the other party's opinion lightly or to inform him/her of a new piece of information.

well.definitionKo: 걱정이나 탈이 없이. 또는 무사히 잘 있는 상태로.
well.englishDescription: Without any worries or troubles, or in a healthy and safe state.

well.definitionKo: 안의 것이 드러나지 않도록 빈틈없이 아주 잘 덮거나 싸는 모양.
well.englishDescription: A word describing an act of covering or wrapping something without any missing part, so that the content cannot be seen.

well.definitionKo: 충분히 익도록 삶거나 고거나 끓이는 모양.
well.englishDescription: A word describing an act of steaming, simmering, or boiling something until it is completely cooked.

well.definitionKo: 충분히 익을 정도로 몹시 끓이거나 삶는 모양.
well.englishDescription: A word describing an act of boiling or steaming something until it is completely cooked.

well.definitionKo: 푹 익을 정도로 오랫동안 끓이거나 삶는 모양.
well.englishDescription: A word describing an act of boiling or steaming something until it is completely cooked.

well.definitionKo: 어떤 일이나 대상에 대해 잘 알고 있는 상태로.
well.englishDescription: In the state of having an accurate and deep knowledge about a certain task or object.

well.definitionKo: 칭찬할 만큼 매우 좋고 뛰어나게.
well.englishDescription: In the manner of being extremely good and excellent enough to be praised.

well.englishDescription: An exclamation used when showing an uncertain attitude toward someone's question or demand.
